name: Cyril Avain
source:
[i]"Your heart belongs to me."[/i]

[i]Driven Vanguard[/i]

A first-class Sylphid who has left many legends in his wake. He's retired from active duty and currently serves as an Academy lecturer while working as an influencer. He's a charismatic role model for the people.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/recordnoah/english/characters/?page=cyril]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
